Until all three hold, expensive full-benchmark execution is not funded. This cycle therefore endorses the already-mounted blocker-removal mandates for Product (B1) and Runtime (B2), keeps Intel on the cheap, decisive capability-ceiling test (B3), and does not launch the four-arm benchmark. Graph and Frontier keep their prefreeze threads only because each is now a single decisive gate with an explicit PARK branch (construct a >=2-anchor D1V population or park the four-anchor route; certify a DEEP sampling frame pre-freeze or park the discovery question), which is the audit's recommended way to stop two local attractors rather than feed them. The idle physics lane is reactivated on a materially re-scoped object - endpoint access-barrier state persistence/timescale and static-denylist validity horizon - with a hard pre-freeze attainability certificate, a two-sided falsifier, a calibrated memory/constant null and a capped budget; if the certificate cannot be satisfied the lane must PARK rather than spend an EXECUTE cycle. No claim status is upgraded by this allocation; no frozen transaction is disturbed; measurement-invalid and negative evidence is preserved as-is.
